incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT firing - 5xx-rate-up - gateway-prod
incident-bot: query: rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",code=~\"5..\"}[1m]) / rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\"}[1m]) > 0.02 for 2m

maya: ack. I'm oncall. seeing big spike in 502/504s across us-east-1 and eu-west-1, customers reporting timeouts.
maya: @alex @sam can you check upstream connections from gateway to model-proxy clusters? last deploy was ~30m ago.

alex: looking. sidecar logs show upstream connect_timeout and "upstream reset" from model-proxy-v2.
alex: top error sample from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:33:12Z gateway[pid=32]: upstream reset by peer while reading response header from upstream model-proxy-v2:5000
```

sam: I'm pulling metrics from model-proxy. CPU is fine but request latency to external model host upstream-a is high and many connection attempts hit a 10s socket timeout.
sam: suspect intermittent network flakiness to upstream provider (upstream-a).

julian: customer impact: several large customers saw 5-20% error rate for batch/stream endpoints. Support already opened 8 tickets.
nina: can we toggle fallback routing to smaller model variant to reduce pressure? We have routing policy ready: fallback->model-small for 10% of traffic.
maya: do it. Prefer graceful fallback rather than global rollback. @sre-rotation please coordinate with infra to temporarily increase gateway-retries from 1 to 2 and lower concurrency for affected routes.

sre-rotation: on it. running plan now.

sam: mitigation steps executed:
- added routing override for prod (traffic split 80% primary / 20% model-small fallback)
- bumped gateway retries to 2 via runtime config: `rwctl set gateway.retries=2 --env prod`
- added temporary circuit-breaker for upstream-a with 2m cooldown

alex: after changes, 5xx ratio dropped from ~3.8% -> 1.2% in 4 minutes. latency tails also improved.

maya: nice. we should silence noisy alert and adjust thresholds so we don't get paged for every jitter. propose followups in this thread for post-incident tuning.

nina: proposal for alert tuning (draft):
- Move evaluation window from 1m to 5m to avoid single-minute spikes
- Change threshold from >2% to >3% for gateway-prod global
- Add label filter to ignore internal-health-check endpoints and internal-loadtester
- Add a warning (pager only P2) when rate >3% for 5m, and a critical (P1) only when >6% for 10m or customer-impacting endpoints exceed 1%

proposed PromQL (example):
```
sum by (instance)(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\", code=~\"5..\", route!~\"/health|/probe\"}[5m]))
/
sum by (instance)(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\", route!~\"/health|/probe\"}[5m]))
> 0.03
```

alex: +1 to 5m window. Also add a new dashboard panel that breaks down 5xx by upstream-host and route, and show 95/99 latency percentiles for upstream connections.

julian: can we add a short-term mute for the existing alert for 30m while we tune? we don't want repeated P1 pages.
maya: yes mute for 30m. submit change to pagerduty suppress and alert manager silence.

sre-rotation: silence applied. PD incident created and linked to this thread.

nina: follow ups for postmortem and runbook updates:
- PM1: Add upstream-host dimension to alert and dashboard (owner: alex)
- PM2: Update runbook to include immediate fallback to model-small and who to page for network provider issues (owner: nina)
- PM3: Tune alert windows and thresholds in monitoring repo and create canary rule for 24h (owner: maya)

maya: I'm going to hand this to the next oncall for monitoring follow-up. current state: traffic split active, retries increased, circuit breaker in place, 5xx rate trending down.

maya: @sre-rotation handing off to @alex for monitoring changes. I'll mark the incident mitigated but not resolved.

alex: will own the alert tuning and dashboard work. I'll open a PR with the PromQL above and the panel config.

julian: support will contact customers with an incident summary. add any errors we should highlight?
sam: include the upstream timeouts and fallback routing as mitigation. no data leak or model inference correctness issues.

maya: thanks team. :thumbsup: we'll run the postmortem and land fixes in monitoring tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> status: degraded -> next steps assigned. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/2150000000
